title_lines: Version-Aware Retrieval and Grounded Sparse Editing
subtitle: Agent-led research across three tasks, with financial QA as a case study
thesis_title: Extensive research led to simple final submissions.
thesis_body: The agent built and tested models; the evaluation ultimately favored exact retrieval and explicit rules.

research_cards.title: Repair spans conservatively
research_cards.models: Greek BERT, Greek Legal BERT, XLM-R, GLiNER
research_cards.methods: Domain adaptation; numeric rules; nested spans; annotation-operation learning; cross-seed consensus.
research_cards.validation: Entity-linked folds; count corrections and newly introduced errors.

research_cards.title: Model commitment, not sentiment
research_cards.models: Tohoku BERT, Rinna RoBERTa, ModernBERT, Nemotron 9B
research_cards.methods: Ordinal decoding/losses; EDINET adaptation; NLI transfer; rationale supervision; expert routing.
research_cards.validation: Source-held-out folds; independent confirmation of apparent gains.

research_cards.title: Compile facts, then test edits
research_cards.methods: Typed fact graphs; constrained planning and realization; evidence filtering; sparse answer edits.
research_cards.validation: Company/report groups and older-to-newer packet confirmation.

gates.title: Entity-aware adaptation · NER
gates.context: Fold-0 macro entity F1. All entity types regressed; stop before the remaining folds.

gates.title: ModernBERT replacement · ICR
gates.context: Source-held-out accuracy. All five folds worsened; 14 corrections, 31 new errors.

gates.title: Qwen 35B fact filtering · QA
gates.context: Fact-set F1 improved, but one company's score fell 0.0544; the safety gate failed.

gates.title: Conservative span consensus · NER
gates.context: 80-row validation: 4 corrections, 0 new errors. Two-seed support; retained for development.

final_cards.title: NER · exact retrieval
final_cards.detail: test queries matched earlier public inputs

final_cards.title: ICR · semantic rules
final_cards.note: New response style changed the choice.

closing_title: Benchmark success and generalization evidence can diverge.
closing_lines: The QA score gap suggests reference-version shift; private references were unavailable.
Our input-based systems handle new inputs, but private superiority over retrieval was not measured.
